mapper.select: select c.*, m.name as from_member_name from hys_commission c left join hys_member m on m.member_id = c.from_member_id where c.beneficiary_id = #{beneficiaryId} order by c.commission_id desc
select c.*, m.name as from_member_name from hys_commission c left join hys_member m on m.member_id = c.from_member_id where c.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: insert into hys_commission (order_id, beneficiary_id, from_member_id, level, amount_cents, status, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{beneficiaryId}, #{fromMemberId}, #{level}, #{amountCents}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hys_commission set status = #{status} where commission_id = #{commissionId}
